newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AVERAGE GROSS SALARY RISES IN JUNE.
newsitem.headline: AVERAGE GROSS SALARY RISES IN JUNE.

text.p: Lithuania's statistics department said on Friday that the average gross monthly salary rose to 822 litas in June versus 795 litas in May.
The average gross monthly salary in the public sector rose to 850 litas in June from 824 litas in May while in the private sector it rose to 779 litas from 750 litas.
The minimum living standard remained unchanged at 110 litas and minimum monthly earnings were unchanged at 400 litas.
The minimum hourly wage was 2.36 litas in June, the same as it was in May.
The highest gross salaries were paid in the financial services sector, which averaged 1,642 litas in June, a drop of 3.8 percent from May.
Gross salaries in the energy sector were the second highest in June at 1,399 litas, a one percent rise over May.

Gross salaries in the social security sector, which averaged 897 litas, saw the highest rate of increase in June, of 16.3 percent. It was followed by the construction sector, which saw a 9.5 percent rise to 1,011 litas.
The lowest gross salaries were paid in the agricultural sector where they averaged 418 litas in June, a rise of five percent over May.
Hotel and restaurants were the second, followed by the social work, health care and education sectors.
